blocks.text: An international open call invites artists to explore the relationship between energy, ecological transformation, technological development and the legacies of resource extraction.

The JUNGE AKADEMIE of the Akademie der Künste, Berlin, in collaboration with E-WERK Luckenwalde, Ujazdowski Castle Centre for Contemporary Art in Warsaw and the E.ON Foundation’s VISIT fellowship programme, invites applications for four international artistic fellowships.

Under the theme Energy Ghosts , the programme encourages interdisciplinary approaches to energy, examining its relationship with colonial histories, environmental exploitation and systems of power. Artists are invited to draw on speculative narratives, mythology and alternative knowledge systems to imagine different ecological and technological futures.

The three-month fellowship supports artistic research, experimentation, and production, and offers opportunities for international exchange and collaboration. Each selected artist receives €20,000 toward fees, research, production, and travel, plus accommodation and studio space.
Venue: Akademie der Künste, Berlin, and E-WERK Luckenwalde, Germany, with programming in Warsaw, Poland.
